# Besito Mexican Restaurant

> Mexican Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Birria tacos, street tacos, handmade margaritas and 100+ tequilas, served with the warmth of a private hacienda near Westshore and Kennedy.

- Phone: (813) 287-4800
- Address: 205 Westshore Plaza, Tampa, FL 33609
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Tacos; Table side guacamole; Margaritas and tequila
- Rating: 4.5 from 5591 Google reviews
